name: PURE H2O
summary: Pure H2O Water Purifier comes up with elegant designs and advanced technological features like 9 lits storage tank. Can take 12 litrs of purified water per hour. Water purifier has various stages of purification process to ensue pure and healthy drinking water.
intro: Pure H2O is a compact and elegant RO water purifier designed to provide safe, clean and great-tasting drinking water. It features a 10-litre storage tank and delivers up to 12 litres of purified water per hour. Powered by Reverse Osmosis (RO) technology, the system helps reduce dissolved impurities and contaminants while the multi-stage filtration system improves water quality and taste. Its countertop design makes it suitable for homes, offices and other spaces with limited installation area.
